verdict.rationale: The open-source Whisper package installs and runs entirely on the user's own hardware (pip install, local CLI and Python transcription, community reports of whisper.cpp running on-device). That implicitly lets users keep audio and transcripts wherever they choose. However, nothing in the evidence documents region or residency selection for the hosted OpenAI transcription API, and no first-party material frames local execution as a data-residency or privacy control. missing for 10: documented region/residency selection for the hosted API, explicit first-party data-storage/residency documentation, independent corroboration of residency guarantees
